## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at 17 Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Located in the heart of Paris, the Musée National de la Marine is perfect for exploring. The grandeur of the Palais de Chaillot, overlooking the lush Trocadero Gardens, makes the perfect backdrop for the Museum, which houses one of the world's best maritime and naval artifact collections.
>
> With intricately detailed models, stunning paintings, intriguing objects, and dramatic sculptures, the museum unveils its treasures in a spectacular, innovative way. Enjoy fun digital and interactive features throughout the tour that will appeal to both young and seasoned adventurers alike.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.40. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 249 ratings and 103 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
